title: Python: the fresh blind-sample draw — labelling to 62 true per repository, both check units, and the one scored run (DEC-303 (a36) item 8; (a103))
description: Filed when GCLI-143 closed. The analyzer is frozen at dev 6602d626 (dist/glyph.js sha256 606a0411e51e4f12ab43dba9c91121add6ed669e0c24ade674e623673dc8a036) and opum-doc read the pre-registration at opum-ai/glyph-cli#268 with the second GO under DEC-303 (a103). DEC-303 (a103) condition two, verbatim: "Condition two, binding at draw time, so write it into the plan you will follow: the draw-time census at the draw seed must reproduce the three recorded hashes (attrs a1336b067b9d, pydantic 8e4aa82abd19, luigi 6c37b636a662), or the draw stops and comes to opum-doc. Read only the operator checkouts at their pins, with no new network clone. Any working copy comes from them, with its HEAD checked against pins.tsv. The scored run stops if dist/glyph.js sha256 is not 606a0411e51e4f12ab43dba9c91121add6ed669e0c24ade674e623673dc8a036. Labels and both reviewer checks are committed before ANY analyzer run on a sample checkout ((a36) items 4 and 7)." A FAIL moves no threshold and spends the sample; the next attempt uses a new seed and new repositories ((a36) item 7, (a99) item 1).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The census at gcli143-blind-draw-1 over the three pinned checkouts reproduces the three recorded sha256 values, or the draw stops and is reported to opum-doc
Every drawn site in each repository is labelled true, false or excluded down the seeded order until 62 true sites are reached, before any analyzer run on a sample checkout
Both check units independent 20 percent samples on gcli143-blind-check-a-1 and gcli143-blind-check-b-1 are committed with the labels, with per-repository agreement reported
One scored run on dist/glyph.js at sha256 606a0411e51e4f12ab43dba9c91121add6ed669e0c24ade674e623673dc8a036 records glyph commit, the dist sha256, each repository pin, and the files and sites read

The per-repository recall, its site-level Wilson 95 percent lower bound and precision, with the reported side figures, are sent to the leader and opum-doc; no threshold moves and a FAIL spends the sample

plan: 1. Draw-time census at gcli143-blind-draw-1 over the three pinned checkouts; reproduce the three recorded sha256 values or stop and report to opum-doc through the leader.
2. Label down the seeded order, reading the code, to 62 true sites per repository; no glyph run on any sample checkout.
3. Tell the leader when labels are ready; the leader spawns the two Opus check units on gcli143-blind-check-a-1 and gcli143-blind-check-b-1 (up to three per repo, read-only).
4. Commit labels and both checks; verify dist/glyph.js sha256 is 606a0411e51e4f12ab43dba9c91121add6ed669e0c24ade674e623673dc8a036 or stop.
5. ONE scored run recording glyph commit, dist sha256, each pin, and the files and sites read.
6. Report the result to the leader and opum-doc; a FAIL moves no threshold and spends the sample.
